conventions.axes: World z is up; gravity acts along -z (scene.gravity is the signed z acceleration, -9.81 or 0).
conventions.capacities: forceCap6 = [tension, shear1, shear2, bend1, bend2, torsion] capacities (N or N*m); compressionCap (N). onset_i = cap_i / k0_i * profile.kappaOnset.
conventions.cellKinematics: u = x - x0 (world, m); theta = world rotation vector with q = exp(theta) * q0 (q0 = identity). Quaternions are [x, y, z, w].
componentOrder: 0 N  axial / normal along n (positive = opening)
conventions.edgeFrame: Local frame (n, t1, t2) = columns of R(q), q = model.edgeFrames[axis].q, same for both attachments. X edges (x,y,z); Y edges (y,z,x); Z edges (z,x,y).
conventions.edgeOrientation: Edge a->b points along +axis: ijk(b) = ijk(a) + e_axis. Anchors at +cellSize/2*e_axis (A, in A local frame) and -cellSize/2*e_axis (B).
conventions.force6: Committed generalized force r = k0 * s(d) * (delta - plastic) (plastic is identically 0: plasticFraction = 0 in every profile) in the edge's current co-rotated frame (slerp-average of the two attachment frames), componentOrder.
conventions.k0: Interface archetype k0[6] (units N/m x3, N*m/rad x3) in componentOrder; k0Matrix = diag(k0).
conventions.massInertia: mass = density * gravityMassVolume; inertia = principal local [m(sy^2+sz^2)/12, m(sx^2+sz^2)/12, m(sx^2+sy^2)/12] from effDims (oriented_interface_core_base.js getCellMass / getCellInertiaLocal).
conventions.nonFinite: JSON has no Infinity/NaN: such numbers are written as the strings "Infinity", "-Infinity", "NaN".
conventions.numbers: Shortest round-trip decimal of each IEEE-754 double (full precision).
conventions.ordering: model.cells / model.edges / model.supports are sorted by id; every per-cell / per-edge / per-support array in a result block is aligned with that order. Ids are the prototype ids.
conventions.phi: Equivalent demand phi = sqrt(sum_i (delta_i/onset_i)^2) with the tension/compression split on component 0 (constitutive.js equivalentDemand). phi >= 1 does NOT by itself imply damage: onset is per-component (box).
conventions.reaction6: Total force (world, N) and moment about the cell centre (world, N*m) exerted by the support on its cell = sum of edge internal forces J^T r on the cell minus the cell's external load.
conventions.rupture: An edge is a rupture candidate when d >= 0.999 or margin = kappa - kappaBreak >= 0 (kappaBreak = 2). Candidates are killed in order score = max(d, margin, phi) desc, then d desc, then id asc, at most maxBreaksPerStep (512) per pass; then detached (unanchored) components are deleted.
conventions.thresholds: onset/break: generalized-deformation thresholds {openN (tension), compN (compression magnitude), t1, t2, b1, b2, tau} (m or rad). Law (damageModel continuum_regularized_v1, damageNorm quadratic): q_i = clamp((|delta_i| - onset_i)/(break_i - onset_i), 0, 1) (component 0 uses openN or compN by the sign of delta_0), p = min(1, ||q||_2), d = max(d_committed, p), kappa = max(kappa_committed, 1 + p). Secant scale s(d) = residualStiffness + (1 - residualStiffness)(1 - d).
conventions.units: SI: m, kg, s, N, N*m, rad. Lattice pitch = model.cellSize (the prototype runs at cellSize = 1 m).

feel.core: xpbd_oriented (XpbdRuntime, engine.tick on the CPU f64 path)

protocol.appParkRule: appPark = first tick completing 5 consecutive stats.quiet ticks (src/app.js SIM_QUIET_PARK_FRAMES): where the real app would stop ticking
protocol.appliedLoads: the XPBD runtime ignores cell.appliedForce/appliedMoment: feel runs are gravity-only (app gravity -9.81) even for scenes whose oracle load case has point loads or g = 0
protocol.blast: blasts are applied to the SETTLED state with {deferSolve:true, captureTransition:false} (the app's real-time click path) and followed by a fresh tick phase
protocol.downsampling: each sample closes a bucket of bucketTicks consecutive ticks; maxDisp*/minDz* are bucket extrema, awake/alive/anchored/ruptures/deleted are the values at the bucket's last tick; ruptures/deleted are cumulative
protocol.stopRule: stop after 5 consecutive ticks with awakeCells == 0 (virgin settle: not before the gravity ramp has finished), else maxTicks

feel.settingsNote: src/app.js syncSettingsFromUi() with index.html defaults; detachedDebrisPolicy is overridden per run (UI default is keep)

scene.label: rc_floor cantilever strip along Y, 8 cells, FIXED root cell, 1e4 N tip load, g = 0

fixJ.description: fixJ: every axis section gets torsionJ = beta*a*b^3 (Saint-Venant, a>=b the two section extents orthogonal to the axis, beta = (1/3)[1-(192/pi^5)(b/a) sum_{n odd} tanh(n*pi*a/(2b))/n^5]); torsionRadius unchanged

static.method: single cohesive_dynamics quasi-static step; edge.damageFrozen=0 on all edges; maxBreaksPerStep=0; no detached deletion

fixY.description: fixY: axis-1 (Y-edge) sections get bendingInertias=[sz*sx^3/12, sx*sz^3/12] and fiberDistances=[sx/2, sz/2] (swap of the prototype order), because the Y frame is (n,t1,t2)=(y,z,x): component 3 bends about t1=z, component 4 about t2=x
